At $50K monthly volume on a typical mix, total cost is roughly interchange (about $975) plus $99 plus per-transaction fees, landing near 2.10 to 2.25% effective.
article.to: Stax charges a monthly subscription of $99 to $199 or more, set by annual volume, plus interchange and $0.15 per online transaction, per its pricing page. There is no percentage markup. At $50K monthly volume, or $600,000 a year, the $199 tier applies; with our 1.70% online interchange estimate and a $50 average sale, that lands near 2.40% effective, against 2.55% for Helcim at the same volume.
